definition: an open paved area outside a building
description: A young woman on a sunlit paved terrace outside a house holds an empty stemmed glass up to the camera and smiles. In close-up, orange juice is poured from a jug into the glass until it is full, standing on a pale stone table beside plates and a second jug. The shot widens: the woman and a young man sit at the laid table on the terrace, oleander bushes and a low wall behind them, and raise their glasses of juice towards the camera.

en.question: What are they doing with their glasses?

de.answer: Sie stoßen mit ihren Gläsern an.
de.question: Was machen sie mit ihren Gläsern?
